name: Bot Portal
tagline: Keeps a running map of the AI tools and bots worth knowing about
description: Somewhere between a directory and a graph. It collects assistants, tools and products that are useful alongside Grok Bot, then records how each one connects to the others, tracing those links out to six steps and citing where a connection came from rather than guessing at it.
author: JaimeBubblehead
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
